lines: a stopwatch clay model, off white matte body with an amber accent ring around the bezel, crown and buttons plain and unmarked, seen from low down looking up, isometric 3d, plain solid black background, soft even light, soft contact shadow, dark shadowed underside for contrast on a pale card, chalky matte surface, occupies two thirds of the frame, no screens dials or gauges.
